// Original test ROMs generated by this project; no commercial game data.
import fs from 'node:fs';
import {makeROM} from './helpers.mjs';
fs.mkdirSync('tests/roms',{recursive:true});
for(const mapper of [1,2,3,4]){
 const data=makeROM(mapper,mapper===3?2:8,mapper===2?0:4);
 const code=[],fixups=[];
 const emit=(...bytes)=>code.push(...bytes);
 const store=(address,value)=>emit(0xa9,value,0x8d,address&255,address>>8);
 const check=(address,value)=>{emit(0xad,address&255,address>>8,0xc9,value,0xf0,3,0x4c,0,0);fixups.push(code.length-2)};
 const serial=(address,value)=>{for(let i=0;i<5;i++)store(address,(value>>i)&1)};
 const ppuAddress=address=>{store(0x2006,address>>8);store(0x2006,address&255)};
 const checkCHR=(address,value)=>{ppuAddress(address);emit(0xad,7,32);check(0x2007,value)};
 emit(0x78,0xd8,0xa2,255,0x9a);store(0x2000,0);store(0x2001,0);store(0x6001,0);
 if(mapper===1){
  serial(0xe000,3);check(0x8000,6);check(0xc000,14);
  serial(0x8000,28);serial(0xa000,2);serial(0xc000,5);checkCHR(0,8);checkCHR(0x1000,20);
 }else if(mapper===2){
  store(0x8000,5);check(0x8000,10);check(0xc000,14);
  ppuAddress(123);store(0x2007,171);checkCHR(123,171);
 }else if(mapper===3){
  store(0x8000,2);check(0x8000,0);check(0xc000,2);checkCHR(0,16);
 }else{
  store(0x8000,6);store(0x8001,5);store(0x8000,7);store(0x8001,7);
  check(0x8000,5);check(0xa000,7);check(0xc000,14);
  store(0x8000,0);store(0x8001,11);store(0x8000,2);store(0x8001,22);
  checkCHR(0,10);checkCHR(0x1000,22);
  store(0x8000,0xc6);check(0x8000,14);check(0xc000,5);checkCHR(0,22);checkCHR(0x1000,10);
  store(0xc000,1);store(0xc001,0);store(0xe001,0);
  ppuAddress(0);ppuAddress(0x1000);ppuAddress(0);ppuAddress(0x1000);
  emit(0x58,0xea,0xea,0xea,0xea);check(0x6001,1);
 }
 const finish=result=>{
  store(0x6000,result);ppuAddress(0x3f00);store(0x2007,result===0x42?0x29:0x16);
  const pc=0xe100+code.length;emit(0x4c,pc&255,pc>>8);
 };
 finish(0x42);const failure=0xe100+code.length;finish(255);
 for(const offset of fixups){code[offset]=failure&255;code[offset+1]=failure>>8}
 if(code.length>0x200)throw Error('Smoke program overlaps interrupt handler');
 const last=16+(data[4]*16384)-8192;
 data.set(code,last+0x100);
 // IRQ handler increments a RAM marker, acknowledges MMC3 and returns.
 data.set([0xee,1,0x60,0xa9,0,0x8d,0,0xe0,0x40],last+0x300);
 data.set([0,0xe3,0,0xe1,0,0xe3],last+0x1ffa);
 fs.writeFileSync(`tests/roms/mapper${mapper}-smoke.nes`,data);
}
console.log('Generated four original banking/IRQ smoke ROMs.');
